title: Asset registration succeeded
description: This event occurs when an asset is registered with Pismo.

id.title: Asset ID
id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It can be used to make redemptions and cancellations.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It needs to be in every API call. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.

registration_mode.title: Registration mode
registration_mode.description: Registration mode of asset. When `single`, asset has only one quota. When `many`, it can be filled with any number of quotas based on `issued_units`.

issuing_date.title: Issuing date
issuing_date.description: Date asset was effectively issued by client

issued_units.title: Issued units
issued_units.description: Number of units asset can support. When `single`, this number should reflect the entire quota. When `many`, it should reflect the number of units available for purchase in the asset.

index_type.title: Index type
index_type.description: Daily accrual calculations are be based on the index type. For example, "di" for DI rate or "pre" for prefixed rate.

index_rate.title: Index rate
index_rate.description: How much the asset accrues per day

isin_code.title: ISIN code
isin_code.description: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) of asset

early_redemption_terms.title: Early redemption terms
early_redemption_terms.description: Identifies an asset that has a different calculation condition at redemption time. If "yes" , `additional_data.early_redemption_attributes` must be set.

additional_data.title: Custom additional information for the asset

customer_name.title: Customer name
customer_name.description: Name of asset quota owner. Can be a company or an individual.

customer_document_number.title: Customer document number
customer_document_number.description: Number of asset quota owner's legal document

type.title: Entity type
type.description: Legal nature of asset quota owner

purchased_units.title: Purchased quota units
purchased_units.description: Number of quota units purchased by asset quota owner

deposit_number.title: Deposit number of the asset quota
deposit_number.description: Optional attribute provided by customer when registering asset quota on Pismo platform

operation_code.title: Operation code
operation_code.description: Optional attribute generated when registering asset quota on Pismo platform

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of asset on Pismo platform

interest_rate.title: Interest rate
interest_rate.description: Interest rate to be considered until date established

floating_rate.title: Floating rate
floating_rate.description: Floating rate to be considered until date established
